The suggested citation is:

```{block, type='boxempty'}
**Heller, R.** (2026). *Scientometrics in R: Bibliometrics, Network Science, and Research Evaluation* (Version 0.1.0). Self-published via GitHub Pages. <https://cttir.github.io/scientometrics-in-r/>.
```

Download the reference as [BibTeX](citation-files/citation.bib) or [.ris](citation-files/citation.ris).
